topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Code of conduct acknowledged at hire and each year; ethics hotline run by a third party; HR sanctions process (POL-01 4.10)
Board audit committee receives quarterly cyber risk, POA&M, CIP compliance, and Utility Services readiness reports; the co-sourced internal audit firm reports to it directly
Organization chart and role table in POL-01; the Director of Utility Services owns the system; the NERC Compliance Manager reports to the General Counsel
Background checks; job descriptions; annual awareness
gap: No role-based security training for the 42 Utility Services staff; Red Flags training lapsed in 2023
remediation: Role-based training for Utility Services and customer operations staff (POAM-019)

control_description: Control owners named in the SSP, policies, and POA&M; performance goals for directors include security objectives
Security information comes from the SIEM, vendor reports, and the inventory
gap: No system description of the Utility Services system; data flows between the CIS, AMI client tenant, CIS export, and meter data warehouse are not documented
remediation: Write the system description with data flow diagrams (POAM-022)

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies published on the intranet; annual acceptance; Utility Services staff briefed on client commitments each quarter
Client contracts set service levels and a 48-hour incident notice; clients receive monthly service reports
gap: No written description of security commitments and client responsibilities (complementary user entity controls) for the clients
remediation: Client-facing security commitments and CUEC list in the system description

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Risk appetite and objectives approved by the President and CEO; Utility Services objectives include client service levels and data protection
Annual NIST SP 800-30 risk assessment with a Utility Services system-level register
Fraud risks considered in the risk assessment: insider export of customer data (R-023), misuse of bulk AMI disconnects (R-014), billing manipulation (R-049), payment redirection (R-033)
gap: Fraud risks identified, but the matching controls (bulk command limits, export rights, partition change approval) are not yet in place
remediation: Close POAM-012, POAM-013, and POAM-022 items

control_description: OT project gate includes a CIP-002 and security check since 2026-09-17
gap: No change risk assessment for onboarding a new client utility or a new partition
remediation: Client onboarding checklist with a security and capacity review

control_description: Annual independent assessment by the co-sourced internal audit firm (P07); monthly security metrics
Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M with owners and dates and reported to the audit committee quarterly

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the P01 risks and the P03 gaps, documented in the SSP and control map
General IT controls over the identity provider, cloud, and SaaS administration
gap: General controls over CIS configuration and AMI command limits are customer responsibilities not yet operating
remediation: Configure CIS and AMI customer-side controls (POAM-013, POAM-022)

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: POL-01 to POL-05 approved 2026-09-17 and effective 2026-10-01
gap: 7 supporting standards still in draft, including STD-03 vendor and STD-11 retention
remediation: Issue the standards per the P06 schedule

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Identity provider SSO and MFA for the CIS, AMI head-end, contact center platform, cloud, and VPN; PAM for IT and cloud administrators
gap: Client data in the CIS export share is protected by group access rather than need; no tokenization of bank account numbers
remediation: Named access and tokenization (POAM-012)

control_description: Accounts created from HR events in the identity provider with manager approval; disabled at termination automatically
evidence: IdP provisioning logs; P07 AC-2 samples (IdP accounts disabled the same day)

control_description: Role-based access in the CIS and AMI head-end
gap: 41 users hold CIS bulk export rights; 22 users can issue bulk AMI disconnects (including client meters) without a second approver; CIS roles are reviewed once a year
remediation: Cut rights to named roles; two-person rule over 50 meters; quarterly reviews (POAM-013, POAM-012)

control_description: Physical security of SaaS and cloud data centers inherited from vendors (SOC 2 reports); headquarters and operations centers badge-controlled
Certified media destruction; shred vendor at headquarters
gap: Paper deposit applications not shredded at 2 sites; no disposal of expired CIS extracts
remediation: Locked bins at all sites; extract retention (POAM-012)

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: MFA on the VPN; cloud edge protections; MSSP monitoring
gap: Edge device patching depends on 1 engineer; known-exploited vulnerabilities not always fixed within 48 hours (R-037)
remediation: 48-hour patch target and a trained backup engineer

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS for client file transfers and SaaS; encryption at rest in cloud and SaaS
gap: No control on bulk movement of client data out of the CIS export share; no alert on large reads
remediation: Bulk-read alerting and DLP rule for the share

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on all endpoints and servers; email filtering; application control on administrator workstations

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Quarterly IT vulnerability scans; cloud posture monitoring; KEV review weekly
gap: Monthly authenticated scanning not yet in place for the Utility Services workloads
remediation: Monthly scans under STD-02

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: MSSP 24x7 monitoring of identity, cloud, endpoint, and firewall events
gap: Meter data warehouse query logs and CIS export access logs not in the SIEM
remediation: Onboard both log sources

control_description: MSSP triage with escalation within 30 minutes for high severity; incident classification in POL-03
POL-03 and runbook B (ransomware with customer data theft), including client notice within 48 hours
gap: Runbook B and the client notification step are untested
remediation: Tabletop with a client observer 2027-02-17; client notification drill 2027-Q1

control_description: Recovery order in the BIA and runbook B; immutable backups for cloud workloads
gap: No tested recovery of the client partitions or the meter data warehouse
remediation: Recovery test of client services (with A1.3)

control_description: Change tickets for cloud workloads; CIS vendor controls code changes
gap: CIS configuration changes for client partitions (rates, bill formats, interfaces) lack approval and test evidence (gap 14); 9 of 20 sampled 2026 partition changes had no approver
remediation: Ticket with approver and test evidence for every partition change (POAM-022; P01 R-049)

control_description: BIA (P05) with Utility Services processes; cyber insurance; storm call vendor
gap: Client continuity commitments not reflected in a written continuity plan for Utility Services
remediation: Utility Services continuity plan with client contacts and workarounds

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Vendor register; SOC 2 review of the CIS, AMI, contact center, cloud, identity, and MSSP vendors (Part B)
gap: No tiering standard yet; CIS and AMI contracts lack Red Flags and 24-hour incident notice terms; bill print vendor not reviewed
remediation: Issue STD-03; contract amendments at renewal (POAM-011, POAM-019)

control_description: Contact center capacity plan with the storm call vendor for up to 90,000 calls a day; CIS and AMI capacity managed by the vendors and reviewed in their SOC 2 reports
Vendor-managed backups for the CIS and AMI; company backups for the meter data warehouse in the backup account
gap: CIS vendor states RTO 12 hours and RPO 1 hour; the client commitments need billing within 1 business day and contact center RTO 8 hours
remediation: Negotiate an 8-hour RTO at renewal (P01 R-021)

control_description: OMS restore test (2026-05-19); vendor DR tests reported in their SOC 2 reports
gap: Client partitions, the AMI client tenant, and the meter data warehouse are not covered by any availability test (gap 14)
remediation: Joint recovery test with the CIS vendor for one client partition, then all 4

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: POL-04 classification (2026-09-17); client data in separate partitions and schemas
gap: Client customer data is mixed with company data in the CIS export share
remediation: Separate client extracts or remove them from the share (POAM-012)

control_description: POL-04 disposal rules (2026-09-17)
gap: No retention limit: client data in CIS extracts kept since 2021; no return or destruction procedure for client data at contract end
remediation: 35-day extract retention; client data return and destruction procedure (STD-11)

control_description: Client contracts define billing timeliness (1 business day) and accuracy commitments
gap: Processing objectives and specifications are not documented in the system description
remediation: Define processing objectives per service (billing, meter data, outage calls)

control_description: Meter data validation, estimation, and editing rules in the meter data management process; daily read completeness report per client
Bill calculation in the CIS using client rate tables; billing staff review exceptions
gap: Rate table changes depend on CC8.1 (partition change approval)
remediation: As CC8.1

control_description: Bill output reconciliation to the print vendor file and payment posting reconciliation, daily per client
CIS vendor maintains stored data integrity (SOC 2 Type 2); company checks client record counts each month
